source_note: PRC import duty rates for goods of Swiss origin, per HS 2022 subheading, as used by OriginPass for the duty-saving estimate. NOTHING HERE IS VERIFIED (verified=false everywhere). MFN rates are filled only where a source states them, and only when every Chinese national tariff line found under the subheading carries the same MFN rate; they come from third-party mirrors (htshub.com, data stamped 2026-01-18, and treayo.com) of the 2026 Customs Import and Export Tariff of the PRC (2026 tariff adjustment plan of the State Council Tariff Commission, in force 1 January 2026), seen through web search results on 2026-10-08, not from the official schedule. A subheading can split into several Chinese 8/10-digit lines with different rates; when only some lines were found or their rates differ, mfn_rate_pct is null. Provisional (暂定) rates, VAT and consumption tax are not represented. No source stating the Switzerland conventional rate (协定税率) under the China-Switzerland FTA (2014 schedule) was found for any line, so every fta_rate_pct is null and no duty saving can be computed yet. The FTA upgrade concluded on 20 August 2026 is not reflected. Before relying on any figure, check it in the official PRC tariff (China Customs online tariff query, or the Ministry of Finance annex) for the exact 10-digit line and for Swiss origin.
